purpose: Fixed-strategy prospective research baseline; not live trading
first_eligible_evaluation_session_rule: First fully completed Vietnam trading session strictly after 2026-11-23; count only sessions with archived contemporaneous evidence
historical_data_caveat: 2022-2026 through 2026-11-23 has already been inspected; never call those sessions pristine out-of-sample
provider: TCBS via existing Stock Bot loader (data may be revised)

execution.position_model: One stock per test case, all cash invested, fractional shares, long-only
execution.profit_factor: Monetary realized P&L on reinvested capital using trade returns rounded to 0.01%; ignores open positions

fixed_strategy.v1: Existing adaptive ADX score threshold and ATR trailing logic in app.py; unchanged
fixed_strategy.sma: Entry filter close > SMA200 and SMA50 > SMA200
fixed_strategy.adx_macd: Entry filter ADX >= 25, Plus_DI > Minus_DI and MACD > Signal_Line
fixed_strategy.v21: V2 score and MACD > Signal_Line confirmation on new entries only
